description.es: Mientras navega o el Maestro trabaja, revisa cada respuesta que pasa por el proxy sin demorarla: cabeceras de seguridad que faltan, claves y secretos expuestos, errores con detalle técnico, listados de directorio y cookies de sesión sin protección. Cada problema queda como hallazgo en borrador, una sola vez.
description.en: While you browse or the Maestro works, it reviews every response that goes through the proxy without slowing it: missing security headers, exposed keys and secrets, errors with technical detail, directory listings and unprotected session cookies. Each problem becomes a draft finding, once.

operations.name: summary
operations.description: What the passive scanner flagged in this project so far (each problem once, as a draft finding), newest first.

operations.name: forget
operations.description: Forgets what the passive scanner already flagged in this project, so it drafts findings again for what it sees next (the existing findings stay).

skills.text: The passive scanner plugin reviews every response that goes through the proxy (yours and the operator's) and drafts findings on its own: missing security headers per host, exposed keys/secrets, verbose errors (stack traces, SQL errors), directory listings and session cookies without Secure/HttpOnly. Before drafting one of those yourself, check the drafts: it may already be there. Its drafts are leads: verify the serious ones (a key that works, an error you can trigger on purpose) before they are approved, and merge duplicates.
